data.name: Neile
data.gender_notes: Neile is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'neos', meaning 'new'. This name symbolizes new beginnings and fresh starts. In Christianity, it can be associated with the new birth of a Christian. The name Neile carries the meaning “New, Young” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Neile usually hope their child will grow to embody new, young and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Neile belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “New, Young.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Neile total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: נילי
in_hebrew.meaning: מי הוא נילי אלוהים הוא שלי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: נילי הוא שם שמשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא שלי' או 'השייך לאלוהים', ומקורו בשם הנביא ניל, שפירושו 'אלוהים הוא שלי'. השם נילי מורכב מהשם ניל וסיומת היחסות '-י', שפירושו 'שייך לי' או 'שלי'. השם נילי מופיע בתנ'ך כחלק מהמסורת היהודית והוא נושא משמעות רוחנית עמוקה.

in_greek.name: Νείλη
in_greek.meaning: Νείλη σημαίνει Θεός είναι ο δικός μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Νείλη προέρχεται από το εβραϊκό όνομα Νיל, που σημαίνει 'Θεός είναι ο δικός μου' ή 'Ο Θεός είναι δική μου'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Νείλη δεν αναφέρεται άμεσα, αλλά η ρίζα του ονόματος έχει σχέση με τη θεολογία και τη σχέση με το Θεό. Το όνομα Νείλη έχει χρησιμοποιηθεί στην Εκκλησία από τους πρώτους χρόνους και φέρει πνευματική σημασία.

in_latin.name: Neile
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Neile derivatur ex hebraico nomine Neel, quod significat 'Deus est meus' vel 'Deus est meus possessio'. In primitiva Ecclesia, nomen Neile non invenitur directe, sed radix nominis habet connexionem cum theologia christiana et relatione ad Deum. Nomen Neile habet significationem spiritualem et usitatum est in traditione christiana.

in_english.name: Neile
in_english.meaning: God is mine or belonging to God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Neile originates from the Hebrew name Neel, meaning 'God is mine' or 'belonging to God'. Although not directly mentioned in the Bible, the root of the name Neile has a strong connection to Christian theology and the concept of devotion to God. Historically, the name Neile has been used in Christian tradition, symbolizing a deep spiritual connection and commitment to one's faith. It carries a sense of divine possession and ownership, reflecting a profound trust and reliance on God.
